gate.description: The result of the gate the project's CLAUDE.md names.

summary.description: One line: the command and its counts.

findings.description: Every finding of the report, one item each. Empty when nothing was found.

line.description: 1-based line in the changed file; 0 when no line fits.

kind.description: gap: a scenario, test or line no test sees (Pass 1); bug: a defect (Pass 2) or a rule breach; nit: style; guard: a check a linter or guard test could make.

rule.description: The rule, scenario or checklist item it breaks, by name (a CLAUDE.md section, an ADR, a scenario).

clean_areas.description: One line per area checked and found clean.

report.description: The review skill's report, as text (at most 60 lines).
